mapper.select: SELECT 1 AS sectionId, B.NREC_DTL_ID AS id, CASE WHEN C.NR_ITEM_NM LIKE '%간호단위%' THEN 'nr-status-2' WHEN C.NR_ITEM_NM LIKE '%수술부단위%' THEN 'nr-status-3' ELSE 'nr-status-1' END AS parentId, B.NREC_DTL_ID AS mdfmCpemNo, 'VALUE' as classType, 'RICH_TEXT_BOX' as controlType, NULL AS maskingType, CASE WHEN C.NR_ITEM_NM LIKE '%간호단위%' THEN REPLACE(C.NR_ITEM_NM, '(간호단위)', '') WHEN C.NR_ITEM_NM LIKE '%수술부단위%' THEN REPLACE(C.NR_ITEM_NM, '(수술부단위)', '') ELSE C.NR_ITEM_NM END || ' : ' || CASE WHEN B.REC_CNTE = 'Y' THEN '예' WHEN B.REC_CNTE = 'N' THEN '아니오' WHEN B.REC_CNTE = 'NA' THEN '해당없음' ELSE B.REC_CNTE END AS content, NULL AS "desc", NULL AS style FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRFAE B ON A.NREC_ID = B.NREC_ID AND B.LST_YN = 'Y' AND B.REC_CNTE IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON B.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.NR_ITEM_NM LIKE '%간호단위%' THEN 2 WHEN C.NR_ITEM_NM LIKE '%수술부단위%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END, C.SORT_SEQ
